t: This is the University of London, a federal public research university. It was set up by royal charter in 1836 as an examination board, awarding degrees to students from University College London, King's College London and similar institutions. It became a federation of constituent colleges in 1900, and it's one of three institutions that have claimed to be England's third-oldest university. The philosopher Jeremy Bentham is buried here. He's regarded as the founder of modern utilitarianism, and he was also a jurist and social reformer.
